output.summary: US Treasury's Iran sanctions campaign threatens mid-tier Chinese banks; China tightened outbound capital rules; PBOC steadied the yuan before the 24 September Trump-Xi summit.

sources.title: Trump's 'Economic D-Day' Against Iran Risks U.S. Ties With China
sources.quote: Treasury warned of plans to "expansively target Iran's business partners"; the initial phase designated nearly 60 entities, individuals and vessels, including many in China and Hong Kong, but spared major Chinese banks.

sources.title: China tightens exit rules, capital controls and tech curbs from September 15 amid security concerns
sources.quote: Beijing is increasing scrutiny of overseas investments, capital outflows and technology transfers; the $50,000 annual personal foreign-exchange cap is untouched.

sources.title: China Tightens Capital Controls the Same Week It Calls the Yuan's Rise "Irreversible"
sources.quote: China tightens capital controls the same week it calls the yuan's rise "irreversible".

sources.title: China's PBOC Strengthens Yuan Fix Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
sources.quote: PBOC strengthens yuan fix ahead of Trump-Xi summit (fifth straight day, reference rate 6.7670 per dollar).

sources.title: Trump Xi summit yuan (Saxo)
sources.quote: "yuan strength already reflected in prices"; a disappointing outcome could push USD/CNH toward 6.80 and beyond.

sources.title: Asia FX flat, dollar creeps higher ahead of U.S.-China summit
sources.quote: Most Asian currencies moved in a tight band while the dollar firmed ahead of a U.S.-China summit that week.
